inj.note: Glover appeared on Green Bay's injury report Monday with a shoulder issue, and it seems like he's truly questionable for Week 12. With starters Sean Rhyan (ankle) and Kevin Zeitler (triceps) also questionable, the Packers might be playing with a makeshift offensive line against a stout Rams defense Wednesday, though if Zeitler is able to go, Glover could shift to a backup role.
